summary: Cosan S.A. filed a 6-K (US equivalent of a Form 8-K material-event disclosure) attaching a Material Fact stating it continues evaluating alternatives for the sale of a portion of its equity interest in Rumo S.A., consistent with a deleveraging strategy. Per the filing, the process has reached the phase for submission of binding proposals by potential interested parties, following a June 29, 2026 Notice to the Market. No stake percentage, price per share, implied value, premium, advisor, or deadline is disclosed, nor has the board approved any transaction. Watch binding-proposal outcomes, stake size and pricing, and any Rumo overhang or control implications.
